accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient gradient overlay (min 60% opacity) for readable white text.
accessibility.aria: Add aria-labels to all icon-only buttons (like the notification bell and modal close button).
accessibility.touch_targets: All interactive elements in the mobile view must be at least 44x44px.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are redesigning the GoRoky client self-service portal to look like a premium native mobile telco app (like Mi Vodafone).
Use Light Theme as default for consumer clarity, using GoRoky Blue (#0A6BFF) for structure and GoRoky Orange (#FF6A00) for highlights/CTAs.
Do NOT change existing `data-testid` attributes. Simply apply new Tailwind styling and structure.
The client home page must be wrapped in a mobile-constrained container (`w-full max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen relative shadow-2xl`) so it looks like a phone on desktop.
The carousels (Product lines, Ofertas) MUST use CSS scroll snapping (`overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory`) instead of complex JS carousels.

For the Admin 'Promociones' page, implement a live preview feature. The admin form should be on the left, and a simulated 'mobile view' should stick to the right side, rendering the Hero Banner, Popup, or Offer Card dynamically as the admin types.
Use Lucide-React for all icons (Bell, User, Home, Receipt, ShoppingBag, Smartphone, Headphones).
Integrate Framer Motion for the login popup modal animation.
Hide the global scrollbar inside the mobile wrapper by adding a `.hide-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }` utility class.
Use Shadcn UI components for the Admin dashboard forms (Input, Select, Switch, Calendar/Datepicker), but heavily customize the Client Portal to rely on raw Tailwind for the exact mobile app feel.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the generous spacing and border-radii defined in visual_enhancers.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds on headers; always use backdrop-blur + semi-transparent white (glassmorphism).
Always use modern button styles (rounded-xl or rounded-full) with interaction animations (active:scale-[0.98]).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Include data-testid on all new interactive elements.
